title: Temperature Converter
prompt: Write celsius_to_f(c) returning the Fahrenheit equivalent (c * 9 / 5 + 32). Give it a docstring.

tests.name: converts
tests.code:
assert abs(celsius_to_f(100) - 212) < 0.001, "100C is 212F"
assert abs(celsius_to_f(0) - 32) < 0.001, "0C is 32F"
assert (celsius_to_f.__doc__ or "").strip(), "add a docstring"
tests.hint: The formula is in the lesson; the docstring is one triple-quoted line.
